Accomplishment
1. Lifetime Achievement Award from Indian Society of Toxinology 2013

2. A medal, The Order of the Rising Sun, Gold Rays with neck ribbon awarded by the Japanese Emperor, 2009

3. Specializing on snake venom, Raman spectroscopy, chemical and biological weapon defense.

4. Published 29 English books as editors and author and 30 Japanese books, and 2 books translated in Hanji.

5. National Institutes of Health (NIH) Career Development Award, 1967-1973

6. National Institutes of Health (NIH) MERIT Award, 1987-1996.
